## Why it works

The title is read twice as a warning (0:00), then the stakes (one of the biggest, most expensive decisions) and the choice question (0:09). A villain line at the sales pitches follows (0:16), then a reveal held back behind "stay till the very end" (0:22, banned for us) and one payoff for each audience. The first prices come by 0:58: tank about three grand, tankless 7 to 8 thousand. Six factors follow, 25 to 56 seconds each, alternating for and against, and the money does the work: "here's the math that the salesman won't show you" (1:41) and a 12-year break-even. The verdict lands at 4:26 ("luxury performance upgrade", 4:30), then which to buy for which household, with the 25-year arithmetic. The held-back reveal is paid only at 6:47 ("most plumbers are afraid of tankless", 6:47), 73% through, which our rules don't allow. It ends on a channel line, a subscribe ask, a tease of future videos and a next-video card. The top comment disputes the tank price ("$500 not 3k", 191 likes), which is why we say prices as ranges (studies/plumbing/comparison/10-opener-teardowns.md, card 27; 11-reasons-to-stay.md).
